title: Paul's Defense Speech in Jerusalem
description: Paul delivers his defense speech to the crowd in Jerusalem, recounting his encounter with Jesus on the road to Damascus, Ananias restoring his sight, and his call to the Gentiles. When the people rage and the commander orders him to be flogged, Paul reveals his Roman citizenship and avoids punishment.
